summary: Backend + frontend regression for the new grading feature. Backend persistence and list-summary surfacing of score/status/auto_fail_count/graded_yes/graded_no/graded_total verified via 5 new pytest cases (all 13 tests pass). Frontend live grade banner verified for: empty -> dash, 1 Yes -> 100% PASS, 1y/1n -> 50% FAIL, 5y/5n -> 50% FAIL, fall_protection.fp_in_place auto-fail -> FAIL with 'auto-fail item triggered' label. Dashboard new stats (Total Reports, Passing, Failing, Avg Score) and per-row GradePill (87% PASS / 55% FAIL) verified by seeding two TEST_-prefixed inspections via in-browser fetch and confirming render. ViewInspection shows a GradeBanner under the print header but it is RECOMPUTED client-side from form data (computeGrade(data)) — it does not directly read the persisted score/status fields. For real submissions this is functionally identical, but it is worth flagging vs the literal review wording 'shows the persisted score and status'. All TEST_ data was deleted at the end.

integration_issues.issue: Banner is computed fresh via computeGrade(data) on the loaded form data instead of reading the persisted score / status / auto_fail_count / graded_* fields from the GET /api/inspections/{id} response. For inspections submitted by the current build the two paths produce identical values (same data + same computeGrade), so the user-facing display is correct. However: (a) if the schema/computeGrade ever changes, historic reports will silently re-grade on view; (b) it does not match the literal review-request requirement 'shows the GradeBanner under the print header with the persisted score and status'. Consider preferring persisted fields when present and falling back to recompute.

action_items: Optional: in ViewInspection.jsx, prefer persisted grade fields when present, e.g. const grade = data.score != null ? { score: data.score, status: data.status, auto_fail_count: data.auto_fail_count||0, yes: data.graded_yes||0, no: data.graded_no||0, total: data.graded_total||0 } : computeGrade(data);

Optional: in Dashboard.jsx the row 'flagged' badge ('Hazard'/'Stop Work') is independent of grade and can produce the visually conflicting combo '100% PASS' + 'Hazard' badge — confirm this is intentional.
critical_code_review_comments: ViewInspection recomputes the grade rather than using persisted backend fields — see integration_issues above.
Dashboard row builds its own grade object inline instead of reusing a small mapper; consider extracting a `summaryToGrade(it)` helper for reuse and consistency with ViewInspection.

InspectionSummary in backend defaults auto_fail_count/graded_yes/graded_no/graded_total to 0 (not None) but score/status to None — fine, but the Dashboard fallback `it.score < 74 ? 'FAIL' : 'PASS'` only fires when status is missing; legacy rows pre-grading will show '—' via GradePill's `total === 0` guard, which is correct.
NewInspection.jsx is now ~535 lines and growing; the live GradeBanner + payload assembly are still readable but the file should be split (sections into subcomponents) before adding more features.
PASS_THRESHOLD is hard-coded to 74 in /app/frontend/src/lib/grading.js; if the threshold ever needs to be configurable per-company it should move to backend config or env.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the 5 live-banner scenarios + dashboard stats + GradePill rows. ViewInspection banner renders but is recomputed (see integration_issues).

seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_GRADE_DASHBOARD_* inspections via in-browser fetch + 3 TEST_GRADE_* inspections via pytest. All deleted via DELETE /api/inspections/{id} at end of each test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live grade computation is solid: computeGrade in /app/frontend/src/lib/grading.js with PASS_THRESHOLD=74. Test ids are stable: 'ppe-{key}-yes/no', 'hazard-{key}-yes/no', 'cond-{section_key}-yes/no' to expand, then '{section_key}-{item_key}-yes/no'. Banner test id: 'grade-banner'. Per-row pill: 'grade-{id}'. To seed data without browser UA blocks, use page.evaluate(()=>fetch('/api/inspections',...)) — calling the public URL via plain urllib gets a 403 from the ingress (Mozilla UA required).
rca of the issue: Only one design-level finding (not a functional bug): ViewInspection.jsx line 131 uses `computeGrade(data)` rather than reading the persisted score/status/graded_* fields the backend now stores and returns. Reproduction: POST /api/inspections with score=87/status=PASS/graded_yes=13/graded_no=2/graded_total=15 but only 2 'Yes' answers in the data, then visit /inspect/{id} — banner shows '100% PASS / 2 YES / 0 NO / 2 ITEMS' instead of '87% PASS / 13 YES / 2 NO / 15 ITEMS'. For real user submissions the recompute will always match the persisted score because both come from the same data + same computeGrade, so end users will see consistent values today. Mitigation suggested in action_items.
